choices.rationale: Authored review question: does the draft preserve support language, or imply implementation? This is not an interpretation of legal effect.

drafts.text: The Security Council established credible governance in Syria within six months and guaranteed elections.

In resolution 2254 (2015), the Security Council “Expresses its support” for a Syrian-led political process “within a target of six months” and for elections “pursuant to the new constitution”. This is historical support language, not a finding of implementation.
